html.body: Date: 2025-03-03 REMARKSClaims 1 to 13 are pending.In the December 5, 2024 Office Action ("the Office Action"), the Examiner first objected to the drawings on the basis that certain features specified in the claims are not identified in the drawings. In addition, the Examiner objected to the specification on the basis of a minor informality. Finally, the Examiner rejected claims 1 to 13 as unpatentable under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as indefinite.Claims 1 to 4, 6 to 8 and 13 are amended to more particularly and distinctly claim the invention, and claim 12 is canceled. The drawings are amended. The specification is amended. No new matter is added. Reconsideration of this application in view of the following remarks is respectfully requested.Drawing Objections The drawings stand objected to on the basis that certain features specified in the claims are not identified in the drawings.First, the Examiner notes that the "open position (O) and closed position (C), for example in claims 1, 3-4, and 8" needs to be shown in the figures. FIGS. 1 and 2 are amended herein to show the closed position (C) (FIG. 1) and open position (O) (FIG. 2).In addition, the Examiner notes that the "more than one shaft (6) located on the body (2) and more than one main actuator (5) enabling each shaft (6)" in claim 12 needs to be shown in the figures. Claim 12 is canceled rendering this objection moot.Specification Objection The specification stands objected to on the basis of a minor informality. In particular, the Examiner notes that the "actuator" is identified with two different reference numbers in par.[0031]. The specification is hereby amended to correct that the second occurrence of actuator is to the "additional actuator (7)." Indefiniteness Rejections Claims 1 to 13 stand rejected as unpatentable under 35 USC § 112(b) as indefinite. Claims 1 to 4, 6 to 8 and 13 are hereby amended to overcome the various issues identified by the Examiner, and claim 13 is canceled.Conclusion It is respectfully submitted that this application is in condition for allowance and such action is respectfully requested. In the event that unresolved issues remain after consideration of the foregoing, the Examiner is respectfully requested to telephone the undersigned in an effort to resolve any open issues. Because this amendment is being filed within three months of the mailing date of the Office Action and because the application will have three independent claims and less than 20 total claims after amendment herein, no fees are believed to be required for the submission of this amendment.Respectfully Submitted, Dated: March 3, 2025 By /John S.
